raw.query: WITH selected AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.superseded_by, CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k_poly_%' THEN 'poly' WHEN d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k_aic_%' THEN 'aic' ELSE 'vision' END AS series, substring(d.run_id FROM '_s([0-9]+)$')::int AS scale_s, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, b.bound_ms, (p.p99_ms <= b.bound_ms) AS under_bound FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id) JOIN provenance.v_sla_bound b ON b.sla_metric = p.sla_metric AND b.bound_stat = 'p99' WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.run_id ~ '^sweeps:(llm_head2k_(poly|aic)|vision_head2k)_s[0-9]+$'), by_scale AS (SELECT series, scale_s, bool_and(under_bound) AS all_metrics_under_bound FROM selected GROUP BY series, scale_s), knees AS (SELECT series, max(scale_s) FILTER (WHERE all_metrics_under_bound) AS largest_passing_s FROM by_scale GROUP BY series), utilization AS (SELECT pc.utilization_ratio FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost pc USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.run_id = 'sweeps:vision_head2k_s2'), ratio_check AS (SELECT count(*) AS v_cost_ratio_rows FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio cr USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND cr.is_current = true AND d.run_id IN ('sweeps:llm_head2k_poly_s3','sweeps:llm_head2k_aic_s2','sweeps:vision_head2k_s32')) SELECT (SELECT largest_passing_s FROM knees WHERE series='poly') AS poly_knee_s, (SELECT largest_passing_s FROM knees WHERE series='aic') AS aic_knee_s, (SELECT largest_passing_s FROM knees WHERE series='vision') AS vision_largest_tested_passing_s, (SELECT utilization_ratio FROM utilization) AS encoder_utilization_ratio_at_aic_knee, (SELECT v_cost_ratio_rows FROM ratio_check) AS v_cost_ratio_rows, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('series',series,'s',scale_s,'metric',sla_metric,'p99_ms',p99_ms,'bound_ms',bound_ms,'under_bound',under_bound) ORDER BY series,scale_s,sla_metric) FILTER (WHERE (series='poly' AND scale_s IN (3,4)) OR (series='aic' AND scale_s IN (2,3)) OR (series='vision' AND scale_s=32)) AS boundary_evidence FROM selected
raw.observed: poly knee s=3; AIC knee s=2; vision passes at largest tested s=32; encoder utilization ratio at s=2 is 0.045 (4.5%).
raw.claimed: poly s=3; calibrated/AIC s=2; vision under bound through s=32; encoder utilization 4.5%.
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded rows show poly passes both bounds at s=3 but ITL fails at s=4, AIC passes at s=2 but ITL fails at s=3, vision p99 is 787.18 ms against 1000 ms at s=32, and encoder utilization is 0.045 at s=2.
